title: Curve Dental Introduces AI-Assisted Notations Powered by Bola AI
markdown:
[Accessibility Statement](https://www.cision.com/about/accessibility/) [Skip Navigation](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/curve-dental-introduces-ai-assisted-notations-powered-by-bola-ai-302411216.html#main)

**_Seamless Voice-Powered Documentation Enhances Efficiency and Patient Care_**

ALPHARETTA, Ga., March 26, 2025 /PRNewswire/ -- [Curve Dental](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4391237-1&h=2937379624&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.curvedental.com%2F&a=Curve+Dental)®, the leading provider of all-in-one cloud-based dental practice management software, announces its most advanced integration yet with [Bola AI](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4391237-1&h=3416157295&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbola.ai%2F&a=Bola+AI), a state-of-the-art AI-assisted notation system. This integration, AI-Assisted Notations, allows dental professionals to dictate clinical notes, perio charting, and restorative notations directly into Curve Dental, streamlining documentation and improving practice efficiency.

**Enhancing Clinical Documentation with AI**

With this integration, Curve Dental users can now eliminate manual data entry by speaking their clinical notes directly into the platform. AI-powered notations ensure that documentation is accurate, efficient, and seamlessly incorporated into patient records—saving valuable time while enhancing collaboration among dental teams.

**Key Benefits of AI-Assisted Notations in Curve Dental**

- **Fully Integrated Workflow:** AI-assisted notes are embedded directly into Curve Dental's platform, ensuring real-time updates to patient notes.
- **Effortless Clinical Charting**: Bola AI's voice-recognition technology allows teams to dictate detailed clinical notes, reducing manual entry and enhancing accuracy.
- **Simplified Restorative Notations:** Record precise restorative plans with natural spoken language, making charting faster and more efficient.
- **Improved Team Collaboration:** Create a unified platform where dentists, hygienists, and administrative staff work cohesively with AI-driven insights.

**Empowering Dental Professionals with AI**

By integrating Bola AI's technology, Curve Dental is further advancing its commitment to providing cutting-edge solutions that improve efficiency and patient care. This AI-powered enhancement enables practices to shift their focus away from tedious documentation and toward delivering the highest quality patient experience.

"At Curve Dental, we're dedicated to equipping dental professionals with innovative tools that simplify practice management," said Jana Macon, President at Curve Dental. "With the integration of Bola AI, our users can now leverage state-of-the-art voice-powered notations to reduce time spent on documentation, streamline workflows, and enhance patient care."

"This collaboration between Bola AI and Curve Dental is a testament to our shared vision: to lead the way in modern dentistry by providing intuitive, AI-driven solutions that enhance both efficiency and patient care," said Rushi Ganmukhi, CEO of Bola AI. "Our AI-Assisted Notations empower dental professionals to work more naturally, eliminating time-consuming tasks and allowing them to focus on what matters most—their patients."

**Available Now for Curve Dental Users**

The AI-Assisted Notations integration is now available for Curve Dental customers. To learn more about how voice-powered notations can transform your practice, [click here](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4391237-1&h=2295306661&u=https%3A%2F%2Fbola.ai%2Fpractice-management-partners%2Fcurve-dental%2F&a=click+here) or call 1-888-910-HERO.

**About Curve Dental**

Curve Dental is the leading provider of cloud-based, all-in-one dental practice management software for dental professionals and practices of all sizes across the United States and Canada. With powerful features like imaging, scheduling, billing, patient engagement, and more, Curve empowers dental professionals to optimize practice efficiency and elevate patient experiences—all from one easy-to-use platform and industry disrupting mobile app. Learn more at [www.curvedental.com](https://c212.net/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4391237-1&h=1571487165&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4333299-1%26h%3D2382591215%26u%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Fwww.curvedental.com%252F%26a%3Dwww.curvedental.com&a=www.curvedental.com) or call 1-888-910-HERO for more information.

**About Bola AI**

Bola AI is a cutting-edge voice-recognition and AI-powered solution that simplifies clinical documentation for healthcare professionals. Designed for seamless integration, Bola AI enhances accuracy and efficiency, transforming how teams manage patient information.
